decision.reason: [ev-93cfde7716c1] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that split align and caching were added for instant metric query results, and it points to PR 11814 for the details. It doesn't name any configuration key, flag or default. So we can't tell whether the feature is on by default, needs to be switched on, or which deployments are exposed (applicability). It also doesn't say what changes for an operator who does nothing (consequence). We would need the PR description, the config documentation or upgrade-guide text to fill in those two open aspects.
